# Summit O'ahu

> Owner-guided circle island tours of O'ahu, Hawai'i, departing from Waikiki hotels. A small-group tour at $149 per person for 1 to 13 guests, and private tours by Mercedes ($1,299, up to 4 guests) or passenger van ($2,199, up to 13 guests). Guided live, in English or Turkish, by the husband-and-wife owners Trey and Nehir. Licensed by the Hawai'i Public Utilities Commission (certificate 01390-C). Book at https://summitoahu.com/book or call/text 808.203.4103.

## Who we are for

- Visitors staying in Waikiki who want to see the whole island in one day without renting a car.
- Solo travelers and couples: the small-group tour has no minimum — 1 guest can book.
- Families and groups who want a private van, or couples who want a private Mercedes.
- Turkish-speaking travelers: Nehir guides private tours in Turkish (Türkçe), which is rare on O'ahu.
- Guests who care more about the guide than the bus: small groups (never more than 13), live unscripted commentary, owners at the wheel.

## The tours

- [Small-group circle island tour](https://summitoahu.com/book?tour=small-group): $149 per person plus Hawai'i GET. 1–13 guests. Waikiki hotel pickup from 6:15am, back in Waikiki in time for happy hour. Full day.
- [Private tour](https://summitoahu.com/book?tour=private): Mercedes GLC 300 for 1–4 guests, $1,299 per tour; passenger van for up to 13 guests, $2,199 per tour. You choose the departure time. Pickup in Waikiki, Ko Olina or Turtle Bay. English or Turkish.
- [Private tour itinerary](https://summitoahu.com/private-itinerary): the default route, customizable.
- [Turkish tours and honeymoon packages](https://summitoahu.com/honeymoon) (page in Turkish).

## Route (in order; may shift with weather and traffic)

Diamond Head Crater & Lookout; Halona Blowhole & Eternity Beach; Makapu'u Lookout; Waimanalo; Leonard's Malasadas; Byodo-In Temple; the windward coast; lunch at Tanaka Kahuku Shrimp; North Shore beaches (Sunset Beach, Pipeline, Waimea Bay); a macadamia nut farm; Hale'iwa town; Dole Plantation.

## Good to know

- Food and drinks are not included; lunch and snacks are bought along the way.
- Rain or shine. Summit cancels only for unsafe conditions, and then offers a full refund or free reschedule.
- Cancellation: small group — full refund 48+ hours out (less card fees), 50% at 24–48 hours, none under 24 hours. Private — 7 days for a full refund. Rescheduling outside those windows is free. Full policy: https://summitoahu.com/cancellation
- Every seated guest needs a ticket; no lap infants; parents supply child car seats.
- Licensed and insured: Hawai'i PUC certificate 01390-C, USDOT 6998685, commercial auto insurance.

## About the guides

Trey and Nehir own Summit O'ahu and currently guide every tour themselves. Between them they have more than two decades of professional guiding, nearly ten years of it on O'ahu (Trey also guided safaris in Africa; Nehir guided for years in Türkiye). The reviews on https://summitoahu.com/testimonials were mostly written about them while they guided for other companies, before they founded Summit O'ahu — the page says so.
